result.note: Tested the drivers of India's 7.8% January–March 2026 GDP growth and the RBI's outlook, both stated directly in the item.

questions.prompt: India's GDP grew 7.8% in the January–March 2026 quarter, the last quarter of FY2025–26. Consider the following statements about this data, reported in June 2026:
items: Growth in the quarter was led mainly by private consumption.
The Reserve Bank of India expects growth to pick up further from the quarter's pace.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Both statements are wrong. Growth was led by a 10.8% jump in private investment while consumption still lags, and the RBI sees growth slowing to 6.6% ahead.
questions.source: led by a 10.8% jump in private investment, though consumption still lags and the Reserve Bank of India sees growth slowing to 6.6% ahead
